reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
I used this app a couple years ago to scan and save old photos. You did a nice job separating pictures, cropping to the edges, and cleaning up the photo.
I just purchased the app again, and I am very disappointed. Photos are not of the same quality once they are scanned. I have better luck snapping a picture with my iPhone and cropping it than I do with this app.

reviews.title: Trouble capturing diverse skin tones
reviews.text: This app doesn’t do a good job of capturing people who have melanated skin. In other words, it doesn’t do a good job of capturing Black people. We have a variety of different skin tones and it just doesn’t do our skin tones justice. I wish I had known that before I spent money on this app. If you’re a person of color, do not waste your money.

If this gets fixed, I’d give more stars, but making my grandma look possessed really deserves negative stars.

reviews.title: Don’t use this app!
reviews.text: I was hoping to use the free version of the app. Maybe that’s where I went wrong. I know app developers need to make a living but £20/month for an app I would use on rare occasions is crazy. So, I used tbsp for the first time at my aunt’s wedding anniversary where I scanned in the photos on display that were 40 years old. When I got home I wanted to save these to my phone, but I couldn’t even access the album without signing up to the 3 day free trial (which would then become a £20/month subscription!). So I signed up for the free trial with the intention of then cancelling before I had to pay anything, saving these photos from the night then deleting the app and using a better app in future. However, in signing up for the free trial. Obviously one has to give card details so the subscription can start once the free trial is over. However, the first payment of £20 was taken immediately! No free trial at all. This app is a total scam. Use free apps like Notes to scan old images instead and use free AI to edit/sharpen images.

reviews.title: Greedy
reviews.text:
The fact that I can’t look at any of my images without your watermark across them - just to even look at them, makes me want to never give you any of my money ever. You’re hardly the only company that can offer this ability. Nothing stinks worse in late stage capitalism, the nasty gross capitalist greed. I won’t be giving you a dollar. And I do subscribe to apps when it’s worth it I pay for multiple photo apps at this.

I’m willing to bet that this is one of the apps that has it in the terms and conditions that they want to keep your image and use it for AI things of their own indefinitely This reeks of that kind of greed. And reading the other reviews now I’m so glad I did not pay this company anything it sounds like they don’t give you half the features. They say they have once you’ve paid for a subscription.

reviews.title: Review after creating 70+ albums
reviews.text: Sure it scans Photos and does that reasonably well but often times it changes the orientation and if you’re downloading or scanning many photos and many albums, it becomes a very annoying fix as you have to fix each image one by one. There are no global commands to select and move out re-orient multiple images simultaneously. The biggest disappointments, however, is when you want to share. There is no global command to allow you to actively select multiple albums and share them simultaneously. The software only allows you to go in one at a time and select. It is very annoying and time-consuming. Compounding this is the annoying pop-up advertisements that are constantly on screen, even as a paid subscriber. When I complained the AI assistant simply said it shouldn’t be there. If so, then fix it. If they would just invest a bit of time and fix some of the basic issues, this would be great software. Additionally, the web based version that you can run on your computer is a little awkward and not as smooth as the cell phone. Overall, I’m disappointed I expected more. I subscribed to scan old family photo albums, and share them to the family. Getting the images into the Software was easy part, sharing is a nightmare.

reviews.title: Shadows on pictures
reviews.text: I love the idea of this app but find it impossible to not have reflections of me on the picture.  I’ve even gone as far as purchasing a music stand; however, that didn’t help. The features in the App are not up to date.  Sharpening the eyes does not look natural.  I can’t seem to sharpen blurry or out of focus photos.  I also find that many of photos are not “cropped” correctly.  If you try to scan something like an invitation or card, most times it’s scanned or cropped as two separate photos.  You definitely need to upgrade the features available on your App.  In addition, I was very happy to see there was an AI Restore feature until I tried it & none of the people in the photos I tried it on looked anything like them.  I was just hoping it would fix the eyes or skin , etc, not totally change how they looked.  I thought the colorization option was genius but found it was more of a hit or miss.  I’d love to see these features updated because I’m finding that for $20 a year, I’m rarely using the App.

reviews.title: Beware: they change the plan when you renew
reviews.text:
I don’t write reviews if they’re not stellar. However I feel it’s fair to warn people that when you renew your subscription after the first year, they change how it works. You then have to pay for and “restore” that you choose to do on previously scanned photos . Here’s my inquiry to them and I have yet to receive a reply. Maybe they will reply now that it’s in a review:

When I bought the app, it allowed me to restore photos without extra cost. You charged me for the app a year later and now I can no longer restore photos beyond 20 credits then an additional cost. That is NOT what I originally paid for and I got no notification that you were reducing the features for the same renewal cost. I want a refund. I had already explained to you all that my phone was stolen in Italy and I was not able to replace it for three months and it was in in that time frame that you renewed the software and charged me for another year. I had no access to cancel my service prior to renewal. You rejected that as well. I’m done being at the mercy of this app and your changing rules. I will leave a review explaining this and go to the better business bureau. Please refund my money for the renewal. 

I will contact my credit card company next.

reviews.title: Glorified Cloud Storage Now
reviews.text:
Don’t use this app.  Photomyne has eliminated the
PhotoShare option that came with the app when I subscribed.  Photomyne, used to let you set permissions for Albums and share them with friends and family based on whether you wanted them to view or to view and edit.  Photomyne eliminated this important feature with no notification anywhere in the app while continuing to charge the same price for the app.  Once you shared an album with someone, they just logged in and all the updates to the album were there.  Now you can only share photos same way you would from your albums on your phone.  PhotoShare was the one reason I chose Photomyne.  I only found out through help
Chat that this huge feature was gone.  The help chat said it was eliminated to add new features.  The only thing that was added was AI which they charge for but throw in a few freebies.  Even with the membership the “new features” cost you in addition to your membership fee.  The photo editing tools have always been weak with the apps sharing ability being its strength which is now gone.  One of the suggestions by Support of Photomyne was just to give out my login to the app to my friends and family.  What???? My original rating of the app was 5 star.  Not even close now.  Now I have to find a new app that does what this one USED to do.  Disappointed doesn’t even describe how I feel.

The trails and credits are too expensive, the ads lied about the app and the creators send the same response to people every time! Creators sort this app out because when the trials popped up I immediately deleted the app and I will never get this app again!

Don’t download this app and I will be writing a letter to the creators about this!

reviews.title: Photos held to ransom behind paywall.
reviews.text:
I downloaded this ‘free to use’ app some time ago and uploaded quite a lot of photographs that I no longer have physical copies of.
My photos are now emblazoned with the Photomyne logo and cannot be viewed without it.
I Emailed support but only get irrelevant answers ignoring my questions or get pointed towards a paid subscription.
This is totally unfair to people who have uploaded their photos in the past on a free app to now find they are being held to ransom behind a paywall.
If this was the intention from the launch of the app, it is simply deception.
Not good.

reviews.title: Disappointing support
reviews.text:
The app itself does a pretty good job and if not considering their support I’d probably give it four or five stars.  But support has been really frustrating.  The app has a support “chat” feature but it takes them a minimum of a day to respond, and I’ve had a problem where they just will not answer the question I asked.  They do eventually respond, but it’s almost like they’re intentionally misinterpreting the very simple question I asked.  I’m guessing the answer probably is “you can’t do that,” but it would be nice if they’d just give me some idea they read what I wrote.

In response to the developer’s reply, I did try the provided email support address with exactly the same results, as recently as this morning, and I still don’t have a relevant response.  Perhaps someone other than Mariya might take a look?
